subject: Scaffold Pacer Next.js app with TypeScript and homepage tagline
body:
Bootstrap the Pacer app with create-next-app (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind,
ESLint) and set the homepage to show 'Pacer' with the tagline 'the coach built by
the run'. Also set page metadata and replace the template README.

subject: Add run data point ingestion and run summary API endpoints
body:
POST /api/points validates and appends a run data point (latitude, longitude,
timestamp, pace, runnerName, teamName) to an ordered in-process store;
GET /api/points returns them in order. GET /api/run summarizes the run so far:
haversine total distance, average pace in min/km derived from distance and
elapsed time, and lap count against a 400 m track.

subject: Add Coach chat page backed by today's real run data
body:
Add /coach chat UI and POST /api/coach, which reloads the stored run on every
reply and passes distance, average pace, per-lap splits and fastest/slowest
sections to the model as context. Extend summarize() with 400 m lap splits
(prorating segments across lap boundaries) plus fastest and slowest sections.
Falls back to a deterministic reply built from the same real numbers when
OPENAI_API_KEY is unset or the model call fails.

subject: Sharpen coach voice and add three starter questions
body:
Rewrite the coach system prompt for a trackside voice: short high-energy
sentences, at least two exact numbers from today's splits per reply, an explicit
ban on generic advice and on numbers absent from the context. Rebuild the
no-key fallback the same way, naming the sharpest and slowest laps. Surface
'How was my pacing today?', 'Where did I struggle?' and 'What should I push on
next?' as one-tap starter questions on /coach.
